invariants.rationale: Since the method always returns the result of 'execute()', it is likely that a non-null result is expected.
It is reasonable to assume prepared records input should not be null at method exit.
Timestamps or instant identifiers are generally expected to be non-null in commit or delete actions.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is required for performing any write/delete operations.
HoodieWriteMetadata#getWriteStatuses() should return a non-null list to accurately represent the status of delete/write actions.
